text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono missed out on 1st place, huh.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was huge! I mean,
running alongside her has some seriously insane presence, right!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Look! I got such a super cool and impactful photo!
Sorry for saying I wanted to take funny ones...!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Buono-chan is usually so soft and gentle,
but in races, she looks so sharp, imposing, and cool~

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, seriously, maybe I should go watch the next race too!
It's kind of getting addictive!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainerrr,
we were so close~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But...
I'm glad we all gave it everything we had.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The audience was having fun and
getting into it, so yeah...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I feel like I can run an even better race next time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, what, what should we do next, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"For my next race, I hope it's one that leaves me
even fuller, waaaay fuller than today~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a body built up patiently over time, I've proven that I can put up a great fight even in sprint GIs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then next...
I want to aim for a GⅠ victory in a mile race!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hah!
That's... a really big mile race, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I just know tons of super strong girls are gonna gather! Like Biko-chan, again!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Yeah, yeah, I want to aim for that!
Let's go with that, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still, jumping straight from sprints to aiming for a Mile GⅠ is a bit concerning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'd like to run a major race
around 1400m.
choice_data_list: Let's fit in the Swan Stakes once along the way, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds good~.
A swan, huh~. Big birds are so nice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, our next target race was set.
Just as we got our spirits fired up again—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Biko-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*.
Bono was amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even though I wasn't 1st,
everyone was amazed by Bono's running.
Their eyes were all sparkling...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...And yet, I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I can't get down in the dumps!
You can't be a hero if you're moping around!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Stand up, Biko Pegasus!
Don't give up, Biko Pegasus!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOH!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...What you just saw is our little secret, okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, in the sparsely populated stands, Taiki Shuttle stood alone, trembling with excitement...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—There was once an American-born Umamusume,
full of power and bright energy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Exciting!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Big and powerful, super exciting! Hishi Akebono is a wonderful girl!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I... I really want to run in a big race with her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Amid a swirl of mixed emotions,
the Sprinters Stakes came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Swan Stakes. To spread her wings and soar,
days of devoted training began!
